analysis.action_validation: replay every SHA256 draw; classify BWE before action; verify requested ratio/cap against proposal and native readback
analysis.clock_assignment: only estimate relay joins when all feasible affine maps cover every held-out marker
analysis.outcome_gate: do not read action outcomes unless all 64 planned sessions are sealed and every transport, actual-run clock, action-randomization, and trace-schedule gate passes
analysis.primary_endpoint: on-time PSNR 1.05-minus-0.65 action effect at BWE >=500kbps minus the same action effect at BWE <500kbps
analysis.replication_rule: positive equal-weight crossed mean; positive means in both acquisition campaigns; positive interactions for at least three of four content capture groups and at least three of four measured network families. Report each source stratum; do not use the 16 crossed cells as independent replicates.
secondary_endpoints: on-time fraction and sampled recorded-video RGB PSNR action effects by BWE stratum
guaranteed relay wire bytes and drops per hold by BWE stratum
analysis.unit: crossed content capture group by measured network family; repetitions and trace windows remain nested

cell_clusters.definition: one independently licensed content capture group crossed with one measured network family

network_sources.dependence_note: UCC LTE and UCC 5G families share the UCC/MISL acquisition campaign; Vienna LTE and Vienna 5G families share the Vienna acquisition campaign. Families are reported separately and are not counted as four independent measurement campaigns.

turn_v2.failure_class: selected local peer-reflexive classification rejected after TURN-backed ICE connection

turn_v3.failure_class: phase-snapshot guard read an unrecorded remote_candidate_type field after the registered session schedule

turn_v4.failure_class: three sessions missed held-out clock coverage; eight sessions violated V4's registered zero-overflow queue rule

turn_v5.failure_class: two sessions missed held-out coverage at the initial high-phase marker m0002

turn_v6.failure_class: 21 sessions missed final held-out marker m0011 and two also missed m0003

prior_no_candidate_action_capture_refere.failure_class: managed WebRtcIPHandling disabled non-proxied UDP; no ICE candidates; no treatment outcomes

question: Does the positive V9 pre-action-BWE-by-ratio interaction for timely RGB PSNR replicate across separately licensed video sources and measured LTE/5G service-rate families?

randomization.draw: unchanged V9 algorithm: first uint32 big-endian of SHA256(networkrlcd-native-v9:{seed}:{trial_id}:{epoch}); low bit 0 selects 0.65, 1 selects 1.05

runtime.network_policy: TURN control TCP and relay/queue UDP are loopback-only

trace_replay.rates_mbps: selected measured downlink throughput resampled to 1 Hz and replayed as local bottleneck service rates

transport.candidate_gathering_acceptance: Both peers complete gathering with only loopback relay candidates using relayProtocol=tcp and zero candidate errors.
transport.media_acceptance: Each scheduled block has more than ten encoded and decoded frames and finite mean encode time; each clip's SHA-256 is verified before serving.
transport.queue_acceptance: Both directions forward at least 100 packets from matching TURN allocation ports, no unexpected sources or send errors; packet and byte replay exactly matches offer/drop/service/forward ledgers; capacity and conservation checks pass.
transport.selected_pair_acceptance: Both pairs are nominated/succeeded and use TURN relay candidates over loopback with relayProtocol=tcp.
transport.trace_scheduler_acceptance: All 18 scheduled measured-rate ticks appear in order in relay events, match the frozen rates exactly, and fall within 150 ms of their registered one-second offsets.
